purpose: Explain the sealed V54 train-only high-backbone failure without development or independent-data access by decomposing the physical second moment at each fixed V54 output threshold into exceedance probability and conditional beyond-threshold amplitude, and by partitioning the total moment into five mutually exclusive fixed output-density bins.

population.probe: the identical deterministic V51/V53/V54 4096-voxel probe per object
population.query_stratum: the domainwise q99.9-and-above query-backbone stratum using the exact boundaries sealed in the V54 train-gate decision

fixed_output_thresholds.source: the four immutable common V54 train-only thresholds
fixed_output_thresholds.strict_exceedance_rule: log10rho is strictly greater than the threshold

decomposition.truth_exceedance_probability: mean indicator of strict threshold exceedance within the fixed top query-backbone stratum
decomposition.predicted_exceedance_probability: mean analytic V54 bounded-mixture survival probability within the same stratum; this is the probability optimized by the V54 Brier terms
decomposition.truth_tail_moment: mean delta-squared times the strict exceedance indicator within the same stratum
decomposition.predicted_tail_moment: mean V54 mixture-quadrature delta-squared contribution above the threshold within the same stratum
decomposition.bin_moment_partition: truth and predicted delta-squared contributions in the five mutually exclusive fixed output-density bins; their sums must reproduce the complete top-backbone moments
decomposition.positive_excess_share: positive part of predicted-minus-truth bin moment divided by the sum of positive excess over all five bins

numerics.primary: 64-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature of each of the five bounded-mixture components, identical nodes and implementation family to the V54 train gate
numerics.analytic_probability: float64 bounded-mixture CDF with exact zero or one outside support
numerics.failure_action: if any numerical or empirical-support requirement fails, report all measurements but make no scientific dominance classification and freeze a higher-accuracy train-only tail integration audit

classification.beyond_threshold_amplitude_dominates_dom: above_q99_999 positive-excess share is at least 0.5 and the absolute log conditional-amplitude ratio is strictly greater than the absolute log exceedance-probability ratio
classification.fixed_threshold_probability_dominates_do: the absolute log exceedance-probability ratio is strictly greater than the absolute log conditional-amplitude ratio at q99_999
classification.common_amplitude_dominance: beyond-threshold amplitude dominates independently in TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift
classification.common_probability_dominance: fixed-threshold probability dominates independently in TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift

branches.condition: any numerical or empirical-support requirement fails
